text:
Nora: Quick FYI from support review: the quotas quickcalc still lists embeddings as \"per-request\". Support asked for a one-line calc for 1k-token embeddings and a short migration blurb about header name changes. I opened a tiny PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9123
Ibrahim: Nice catch. I'll update the SDK examples to prefer the usage helper and add the token-based calc. Will replace raw header parsing with `client.usage.fetchRange()` in the main examples and keep a raw-header appendix. ETA ~20m.
Lila: I'll swap the grafana permalink at the bottom to the public metering dashboard (the current one 403s). Also changing the panel id to `metering:tokens_total`. I'll open a link-fix PR and run local link-check.
Nora: Please add a short migration note mapping old headers -> new ones (e.g., X-Req-Count -> X-Usage-Tokens) and a paste-ready sentence for support: \"Embeddings are now billed per token; estimate tokens = ceil(chars/4).\"
Ibrahim: Adding migration note. Short snippet I'll include in the docs (python):
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient(api_key="${REDWOOD_API_KEY}")
usage = c.usage.fetch_range(start="2026-03-01", end="2026-03-02")
print(usage.total_tokens)
```
Lila: Link PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9126 0ran local link-check, public url resolves.
MergeBot: CI: lint OK for PRs 9123 and 9126; examples-smoke queued for python+node; link-check queued.
Ibrahim: Pushed SDK snippet + migration blurb to 9123. Kept raw-header example under an \"Advanced\" heading showing `X-Usage-Tokens` and `X-Burst-Remaining`.
Lila: Merged 9126 (grafana link). Rebase 9123 and I'll run another link-check.
Ibrahim: Rebasing now and fixed a tiny markdown lint nit. PR 9123 updated.
MergeBot: examples-smoke passed; link-check passed after merge. Ready to land 9123.
Nora: Great work. I'll merge 9123 and add a short changelog line: \"Embeddings billed per-token; header names updated; public metering dashboard link.\" If any regressions, ping here.
MergeBot: merged PR 9123. changelog entry auto-created and #support notified.
